mods.name: Iris
mods.reason: Iris uses OpenGL. Shader packs cannot run on Vulkan.

mods.name: Oculus
mods.reason: Oculus uses OpenGL. Shader packs cannot run on Vulkan.

mods.name: Embeddium
mods.reason: Embeddium does not support Minecraft 26.x. Use Sodium for NeoForge 26.2.

mods.name: OptiFine
mods.reason: OptiFine requires OpenGL and is incompatible with this Vulkan instance.

mods.name: Nvidium
mods.reason: Nvidium directly calls OpenGL and requires NVIDIA desktop extensions.

mods.name: Voxy
mods.reason: This OpenGL Voxy build calls OpenGL directly. Check a Vulkan-compatible release before enabling it.

mods.name: Sodium
mods.evidenceRef: Vulkan support since 0.9.0; 0.9.2 nests GL backend mixins (GlDeviceMixin, GLDrawContext) beside VK draw batches. Supports Mojang's Vulkan backend; its OpenGL classes only run on the GL backend. Checked 2026-11-09 against the 26.2 NeoForge jar from Modrinth

mods.name: ImmediatelyFast
mods.evidenceRef: Vulkan-compatible since 1.16.0; 1.16.5 mixes into GlCommandEncoder/GlSurface only. Supports Mojang's Vulkan backend; its OpenGL classes only run on the GL backend. Checked 2026-11-09 against the 26.2 NeoForge jar from Modrinth

mods.name: ModernFix (mVUS)
mods.evidenceRef: mVUS fork for 26.2; 5.27.21 touches GL only in AsyncLoadingScreen. Supports Mojang's Vulkan backend; its OpenGL classes only run on the GL backend. Checked 2026-11-09 against the 26.2 NeoForge jar from Modrinth

mods.name: Distant Horizons
mods.reason: Distant Horizons can't load worlds: its database library has no Android build yet.
mods.evidenceRef: 3.3.3 bundles a relocated sqlite-jdbc (dh_sqlite) and zstd-jni with glibc/musl/BSD/macOS/Windows natives only, so it fails at world load on Android. Its Vulkan rendering is fine (since 3.1.0). Checked 2026-11-11 against the 26.2 NeoForge jar from Modrinth

mods.name: Entity Culling
mods.evidenceRef: 1.11.3 has no OpenGL references. Supports Mojang's Vulkan backend; its OpenGL classes only run on the GL backend. Checked 2026-11-09 against the 26.2 NeoForge jar from Modrinth

mods.name: FerriteCore
mods.evidenceRef: 9.0.0 has no OpenGL references. Supports Mojang's Vulkan backend; its OpenGL classes only run on the GL backend. Checked 2026-11-09 against the 26.2 NeoForge jar from Modrinth

mods.name: Controlify
mods.reason: Controlify can't see controllers on Android yet. Cofre's built-in controller support works without it.
mods.evidenceRef: 3.5.3 has no OpenGL references, but it only loads its bundled glibc linux-aarch64 libSDL3.so and there is no Android SDL3, so it finds no controller. Checked 2026-11-11 against the 26.2 NeoForge jar from Modrinth

mods.name: YetAnotherConfigLib
mods.evidenceRef: 3.9.7 has no OpenGL references. Supports Mojang's Vulkan backend; its OpenGL classes only run on the GL backend. Checked 2026-11-09 against the 26.2 NeoForge jar from Modrinth
